title: Patient Registry Thalidomide Embryopathy
summary: Aim of the  Patient Registry is to study the consequences of birthdefects and aging in the group of people with thalidomide embryopathy. Data collection will be performed as interview based questionaire composed of international established  questionaire-tools like PHD, ICF.

interventions.name:
People with Thalidomide Embryopathy:
The aim of the register is to investigate the effects of congenital malformations against the background of aging using the group of people affected by thalidomide (thalidomide embryopathy) in order to be able to derive concrete recommendations for medical care

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
People with Thalidomide Embryopathy
Exclusion criteria:
People without Thalidomide Embryopathy
